Elaine / BrightWave team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached are the redlines we discussed (MSA_BrightWave_redline_v3.docx) and the updated order form draft (OrderForm_BW_20250912.xlsx). Two asks so we can package this for DocuSign: 

1) Confirm the BrightWave signatory and whether you require witness/notary for the Order Form (you mentioned procurement sometimes requires a witness). Please confirm the exact name and title to populate the envelope and the email address for signing.

2) Confirm the purchase order (PO) number or indicate if we should leave the PO field blank until signing.

Internal note: Marissa / Laura — once Elaine confirms, we should:
- Produce a single clean PDF (clean-copy) with tracked changes accepted and a cover page listing signing order
- Create DocuSign envelope with role order: BrightWave signatory -> Redwood signatory (we should decide who will sign for Redwood)
- Include PO and routing metadata in the envelope fields so procurement can automatically ingest.

Target: have the envelope ready for sending by EOD Monday (2025-09-15). Elaine, if that timeline is tight for you, tell us preferred send window.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez

Diego —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Signing authority: Primary signatory will be Mark Anders, CFO (mark.anders@brightwave.com). He has authority for agreements up to $1M. For anything above that we escalate to the CEO, but this deal is within his authority.
- Witness/notary: We do not need a notary for the MSA itself. The Order Form will need a witness signature per our procurement policy, but our procurement team (procurement@brightwave.com) can handle witness identification — they normally supply the witness name/email after DocuSign initiation.
- PO number: Not available yet. Please leave the PO field as a fillable envelope field; we'll supply the PO number prior to final execution and before payment initiation.

We prefer the signing order: BrightWave (Mark) -> Redwood. Please set the envelope to allow the witness to add their signature after Mark signs. Also add a moderate reminder cadence (48h then 5d).

I'll get procurement to confirm witness workflow separately — copying them here.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Counsel, Contracts | BrightWave Therapeutics
elaine@brightwave.com
